{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue values
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure only completed orders are considered for conversion
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if the groups are comparable by customer_segment
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:\n', 
      sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
